findings.text: Acceptance 3; F5 ADDRESSED for six matches ([6,5],[4,3],[2,1]), but dense results still disappear. In-memory real-route test: fix ctx.now, post 201 'needle' messages, follow cursors with limit=50; page counts [50,50,50,50,0], missing ID 1. untilTs re-fetches the same newest 200 before filtering IDs. Apply an ID bound before the server cap (request shared API support if needed), and cover >200 matches in one second and concurrent arrivals.

Acceptance 3: a capped fetch with a short client page incorrectly ends pagination. In-memory real-route test: 20 'needle' posts at T, 190 at T+1, limit=30; cursor walk returns page counts [30,30,30,30,30,30,20], no cursor, 200/210 matches (IDs 1-10 missing). Removing page.length === limit makes this test reach 210/210. Preserve continuation when the fetch hits SEARCH_FETCH, even for a partial page, and add this boundary test.
